scope:
Original e1cf0..e24ac yaw search with supplied query and trig leaves.

Executes native vector-length/refinement, angular wrapping, arithmetic, control
flow and mutations. Trig/atan values, closest/visibility rays and placement
contacts are supplied; geometry, Havok, RTTI and controller acquisition are not
executed. XYZ query coordinates are compared; scratch vector W is uninitialized
in the source and excluded. Uses finite normal inputs only.
